Verified production baseline

These captures correspond to production deployment appgdep_6ab5de65b7d48191a9c98e2202637567, version 1, built from source revision ecfc27f8ca5182465df891a0f516278f9af9fb7f.

The isolated browser audit found no console errors or exceptions, external-origin requests, failed resources, unnamed interactive controls, or horizontal page overflow at either viewport. The document accessibility root was present, and keyboard Tab reached a named link with a visible focus outline. These focused checks are not a complete accessibility certification.
